title: LinkedIn to Personal Email Finder
description: Add LinkedIn profile URLs you already have. $50 per 1,000 personal emails found. A profile with no exact match is free.

lawfulUse.title: Professional use and lawful basis
lawfulUse.description: Confirm this run is for professional outreach, recruiting, or account-based marketing, and that you have a lawful basis to use a match. Mawsool does not send the email for you.

urls.title: LinkedIn profile URLs
urls.description: Profile URLs you already have, such as linkedin.com/in/...

urlsCsv.title: Or paste CSV
urlsCsv.description: A url or linkedinUrl column. One URL per row is also accepted.

fileUrl.title: Or upload a CSV file
fileUrl.description: CSV with a url or linkedinUrl column. HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay, and recruiter exports all work.

maxUrls.title: Maximum URLs
maxUrls.description: Cost-control cap. Maximum 50,000. You pay only for profiles that return a personal email.

concurrency.title: Concurrent lookups
concurrency.description: How many profiles to look up at the same time.

resumeId.title: Resume ID (optional)
resumeId.description: Reuse this ID to skip profiles that already returned an email.

freshStart.title: Look up finished profiles again
freshStart.description: Turn this on to ignore saved progress and look up the whole list again.
